values.subject: Jiaxing Zhizao: 44-Person Visit Schedule and Quotation
values.body_text: The July 21 time slot is still available. Forty-four people can enter the workshop in two staggered groups, including a briefing and basic protective equipment. The visit fee is RMB 18,000, and an invoice made out to the company can be issued. The RMB 5,000 deposit is due after the time slot is confirmed and will be refunded within fifteen working days after the visit ends. Earplugs and dust masks are part of the upgrade package; would you like to add them separately?
